# Ascora

Ascora is a cloud-based field service management software designed to streamline operations for service-based businesses, offering features such as job scheduling, invoicing, customer management, and mobile access.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ascora/.

## Actions

- **Create Quotation**: Create a new quotation.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a specific customer by id.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a specific customer by id.
- **Get Customers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of customers.
- **Get Jobs** (read-only): Retrieve jobs.
